text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Right here, suddenly BOOM to the front!
Twirl-twirl KA-BLAM!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"And then, zoom zoooom!
Turbo engine at full throttle! I call it:
'Operation: Explosive Live Stage Surprise'!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day after school, Twin Turbo told me
she'd found a "way to have fun at concerts,"
and when I listened to her idea—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Supposedly, as a surprise, she's going to suddenly leap off the stage mid-dance and run around through the audience...
choice_data_list: You probably shouldn't do that, really...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~!? Why not!?
It'd be so fun!!
Operation: Surprise 'Em with a Bang at the Live Concert!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hey, Turbo. What are you making a fuss about?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Hishi Ama! Guess what, guess what!
Turbo, at the live show—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: *Sigh*... Listen here.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
If you do that, it'll cause trouble for everyone!
Even if it's a surprise, discuss it with your friends first!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat!? Then the guests are
the only ones who'll be surprised!!
That's no fun at all!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Listen, Turbo. Having fun isn't supposed to be all about yourself.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Wouldn't it feel a whole lot better
if everyone got to enjoy it together
instead of just yourself?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
B-But still! I'm sure everyone else
is having fun too...!!
choice_data_list: Shall we try to think of another way?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Not you too, Trainer?!
Aargh! Enough! Turbo doesn't wanna be lectured!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hey!
...Geez, what an impossible kid.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Chasing after the fleeing Twin Turbo,
and finally catching up to her—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat!? You're both saying the same thing!?
Why!? Turbo didn't do anything wrong!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: However, just as Hishi Ama-san said, I do not believe a concert should end in mere self-satisfaction.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Indeed, there is a risk of causing chaos. In that case, we should announce our plan in advance, have everyone review it thoroughly, and then—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah!! I don't wanna hear it, I don't wanna hear it!!
Turbo doesn't get it!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"At this rate, she looks like she's going to start running again.
I have to calm her down somehow—"
choice_data_list: Let's settle it with a race!
Let's settle this with barbell lifts!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? Settle it with a race...
You and Turbo are gonna run!?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo's totally gonna win, no question!!
'Cause Turbo's an Umamusume!
choice_data_list: You won't know unless you try!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: O-Ohh...!? Trainer, you're really fired up, huh?!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Got it, I accept your challenge!!
If Turbo wins,
we're doing 'Operation Big Boom Live Surprise'!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"*pant, pant, pant*!
Turbo wins after all...!"
choice_data_list: To run with all your might...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Because it's a match!!
There's no point if we don't give it our all!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
“Still, it was so much fun! I heard Trainer's roar
of 'WHOOOA!' from behind,
and Turbo went 'WHOOOA!' too!”
choice_data_list: Because we ran with the same feelings.
Because we ran with the same feelings.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I see! That's why it's so much fun!
Because we felt the same way――

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Huh? Wait...
Umm...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
...Would 'Operation: Big Live Surprise!'
be more fun to pull off together with everyone?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"...I see. Got it!!
Turbo's gonna do it with everyone!!
I'll go tell everybody to join in!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With her eyes sparkling, Twin Turbo
ran off toward her friends.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? Trainer!?
What's with the barbell... Why!?
choice_data_list: Because a showdown would make things simple!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...Even so,
challenging an Umamusume to a match is a bit...—"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
In that case, how about wearing weights on your arms
as a handicap?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Got it! No matter the handicap,
Turbo's gonna win!! And then,
it's time for "Operation: Concert Boom Surprise"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, it became a barbell-lifting contest with Twin Turbo. In the end,
despite receiving a handicap, I still lost...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Turbo wins--!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I took the handicap and gave it my all.
I wasn't supposed to lose, but having pushed myself to the limit,
I feel strangely good.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you did your best!!
Turbo did her best too!
Hehehe, that was so much fun!
choice_data_list: Yeah, we were both serious about it, so...
Yeah, because both of you were giving it your all...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!!
It's so fun because we worked hard together!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
...Nga? Huh? Huhhh?
Because we worked hard... together, it's fun?
Hmm???

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Twin Turbo seems to have started realizing something. Could this be... a chance?!
choice_data_list: If we all carry out the plan together...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
!! Even more fun!?
Way more fun than Turbo doing it all by herself!?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Then I'll do that!! Turbo likes having lots and lots of fun better!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Hopping with excitement, Twin Turbo dashed off to tell the others the plan.
